parameters.jsCode: return items;

// Normalizes the selected keyword row into predictable runtime variables.
// Uses client context that was attached in Pick Next Row.

const row = $json;
const yn = (v) => String(v || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'yes';

return [{
  json: {
    website: row.__clientWebsite || '',
    tab: row.__clientTab || '',
    profile_url: row.__clientProfile || '',
    config_url: row.__clientAbout || '',
    wp_username: row.__wpUsername || '',
    wp_application_password: row.__wpApplicationPassword || '',
    wp_category_id: row.__wpCategoryId || "",
report_cc_email:
  row.__reportCcEmail ||
  "",
    row_number: row.row_number,

    keyword: row["Primary keyword"],
    source_post_url: row["source_post_url"] || row["Source Post URL"] || "",
    target_location: row["Target location"] || "",
    intent: row.Intent || "commercial",
    topic_mode: row["Topic mode"] || "standard",
    content_type: row["Content type"] || "blog",
    output_format: row["Output format"] || "html",

    cta_policy: row["CTA Policy"] ?? "",
    faq: yn(row.FAQ),
    meta_field: yn(row.meta_field),

    status: row.Status || "",
content_ai_model:
  String(
    row.__contentAiModel ||
    "gpt-4.1-mini"
  ).trim(),
web_search: yn(row.web_search),
prompt_for_web_search: row.prompt_for_web_search || "",
distribution_mode:
  row.__distributionTier || "",
run_mode:
  row.__runMode || "cron",

run_id:
  row.__run_id ||
  "",

client_key:
  row.__clientKey || "",
daily_post_limit: row.__dailyPostLimit || 1,
run_every_hours: row.__runEveryHours ?? 24,
ignore_schedule: row.__ignoreSchedule || false,
ignore_daily_limit: row.__ignoreDailyLimit || false,
run_counts_toward_quota: row.__runCountsTowardQuota || false,
distribution_targets:
row.__selectedTargets || ""
  }
}];

parameters.jsCode:
const row =
  $json ||
  {};

const client =
  $("Loop Clients").item.json ||
  {};

const activeRunId =
  String(
    client.__active_run_id ||
    client.active_run_id ||
    ""
  ).trim();

const clientKey =
  client.__client_key ||
  String(
    client.Website ||
    client.website ||
    client.Tab ||
    client.tab ||
    "client"
  )
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(
      /^https?:\/\//,
      ""
    )
    .replace(
      /^www\./,
      ""
    )
    .replace(
      /\/+$/,
      ""
    );

const runId =
  activeRunId ||
  [
    clientKey,
    row.row_number ||
      "row",
    Date.now(),
  ]
    .join("-")
    .replace(
      /[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/g,
      "-"
    );

const now =
  new Date()
    .toISOString();

return [{
  json: {
    ...row,

    __run_id:
      runId,

    __needs_create_run:
      !activeRunId,

    __is_resume:
      Boolean(activeRunId),

    __new_run_client_key:
      clientKey,

    __new_run_source_tab:
      client.Tab ||
      client.tab ||
      "",

    __new_run_source_row_number:
      row.row_number ||
      "",

    __new_run_keyword:
      row["Primary keyword"] ||
      "",

    __new_run_schedule_key:
      client.__schedule_key ||
      "",

    __new_run_status:
      "active",

    __new_run_stage:
      row.__retryExistingPublish ===
      true
        ? "MAIN_PUBLISH_FAILED"
        : "STARTED",

    __new_run_started_at:
      now,

    __new_run_updated_at:
      now,
  },
}];

parameters.jsCode:
const row = $json || {};

const stage = String(
  row.__runStage || ""
)
  .trim()
  .toUpperCase();

const distributionMode =
  row.__distributionTier ||
  "";

const distribute =
  ![
    "",
    "none",
    "no",
    "false",
    "off",
    "disabled",
    "skip",
  ].includes(
    String(distributionMode)
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
  );

const mainPublishStatus =
  stage === "MAIN_PUBLISHED"
    ? "PUBLISHED"
    : stage === "MAIN_DRAFT_CREATED"
      ? "DRAFT_CREATED"
      : "SKIPPED";

const sourcePostUrl =
  row.source_post_url ||
  row["Source Post URL"] ||
  row.__runSourcePostUrl ||
  "";

return [{
  json: {
    tab:
      row.__clientTab || "",

    row_number:
      row.row_number || "",

    status:
      "DONE",

    slug:
      row.slug || "",

    meta_title:
      row.meta_title || "",

    meta_description:
      row.meta_description || "",

    content_output:
      row.content_output || "",

    generated_title:
      row.generated_title || "",

    website:
      row.__clientWebsite || "",

    keyword:
      row["Primary keyword"] || "",

    source_post_url:
      sourcePostUrl,

    wp_post_id:
      row.__runMainPostId || "",

    wp_post_link:
      sourcePostUrl,

    main_publish_status:
      mainPublishStatus,
publish_wp:
  mainPublishStatus !== "SKIPPED",

wp_type:
  row.wp_type ||
  "post",

wp_status:
  mainPublishStatus === "PUBLISHED"
    ? "publish"
    : mainPublishStatus === "DRAFT_CREATED"
      ? "draft"
      : "",

generate_image:
  row.generate_image ??
  Boolean(
    row.feature_img_url ||
    row.__runFeatureImgUrl ||
    row.feature_img_wp_id ||
    row.__runFeatureImgWpId
  ),
    feature_img_url:
      row.feature_img_url ||
      row.__runFeatureImgUrl ||
      "",

    feature_img_wp_id:
      row.feature_img_wp_id ||
      row.__runFeatureImgWpId ||
      "",

feature_img_status:
  row.feature_img_status ||
  row.__runFeatureImgStatus ||
  (
    row.feature_img_url ||
    row.__runFeatureImgUrl ||
    row.feature_img_wp_id ||
    row.__runFeatureImgWpId
      ? "DONE"
      : "SKIPPED"
  ),
    image_warning:
  row.image_warning ||
  row.__runImageWarning ||
  "",

image_generation_failed:
  Boolean(
    row.image_warning ||
    row.__runImageWarning ||
    row.feature_img_status ===
      "FAILED_CONTINUED" ||
    row.__runFeatureImgStatus ===
      "FAILED_CONTINUED"
  ),

    distribution_mode:
      distributionMode,

    distribution_targets:
      row.__selectedTargets || "",

    distribute,

    send_publish_report:
      true,

    run_mode:
      row.__runMode || "cron",

    run_id:
      row.__run_id ||
      row.__activeRunId ||
      "",

    client_key:
      row.__clientKey || "",

    daily_post_limit:
      row.__dailyPostLimit ?? 1,

    run_every_hours:
      row.__runEveryHours ?? 24,

    ignore_schedule:
      row.__ignoreSchedule || false,

    ignore_daily_limit:
      row.__ignoreDailyLimit || false,

    run_counts_toward_quota:
      row.__runCountsTowardQuota || false,
    report_cc_email:
  row.report_cc_email ||
